verdicts.reason: A keeps a strong, large two-line headline and a prominent CTA, but the alignment is mixed. GROVE is centred, the headline and body are left-aligned, and the pills and CTA are pushed right. The two pills almost touch, which makes the lower block look ragged. B shrinks the headline and CTA to weak sizes and squeezes the copy into a wide measure that leaves 'bottles.' as an orphan. It also drops the tilted Free Delivery badge into the pill row, where it looks like clutter, and leaves about 140px of dead space at the bottom while the text block sits cramped mid-canvas.
